audience: Families looking for a weekend at the baths.
goal: Reel in the style of the client's own reference reel: photos with a slow camera, a two-line caption per scene, through the steam of the hot springs, closing on the logo.

avoid: sun and moon discs (light_clock, day_arc, coffee_to_evening)

concepts.name: A través del vapor
concepts.idea: Cada escena aparece cuando el vapor de las termas sube, cubre el cuadro y se disipa sobre la foto siguiente.
concepts.carry: el vapor y el lugar del texto

concepts.name: Fiel a la referencia
concepts.idea: Fundidos simples entre fotos con el mismo sistema de texto de la referencia.

concepts.name: Pausa
concepts.idea: Cuatro fotos largas con palabras que aparecen de a una.

decisions: Reference: the client's reel 'Hace cuánto no cortás con la rutina de verdad' (15 s, two-line captions with a blur-in, a moss box on one word, dissolves, cream card with the logo). verify.py --analyze on it: still 0.25, longest rest 2.7 s, 1 hard cut.

Liberty taken (the user asked for it): scene changes happen through rising steam instead of plain dissolves; captions are new lines written in the same voice; photos mix the hot springs and the bungalow interior.
No music was supplied: the sound is the cutroom effects palette placed from the render's events.
First draft: captions were legible for 0.8 s (verifier FAIL); now five scenes of 2.3 s and the captions enter sooner. The sunrise photo was dropped to make room.
Rhythm: equal scenes read as a metronome (verifier FAIL). Two short breaths without a caption (sunrise steam, kitchen) now sit between the long captioned scenes, and each push has its own curve.

Second version after the quality comparison with onetake (2026-11-11): type set in Instrument Serif + Inter (look 'linen' faces, client colours kept); captions through <Caption>, gone 18 frames before each change; steam cooler and thinner with no flat white wash (verifier burnt_frames 10 -> 0); two alternating steam shapes; finals from PNG frames with the whole-frame shutter. This is a new draft for review, not the one shown before.
WARN [curves] accepted: the pushes already use four different curves and the steam alternates two shapes; the measured moves are dominated by the steam swell.
WARN [rhythm] (longest beat 2.9x the shortest) accepted: within 0.1 of the target, the two breaths without captions already break the cadence.
Still share 44 % against the reference's 19-25 %: calmer than the client's reference reel; offered to tighten the rests.
